title.en: One candle: what four things does it tell you?
title.zh-Hans: 一根K线，到底告诉你哪四件事？

timing_note: Line and word timings are aligned to measured narration wavs (episodes/narration-timing.json); words are spread proportionally within each measured line. On-screen zh-Hans captions follow the English narration timing.

narration.command_template: python -m mlx_audio.tts.generate --model mlx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base-8bit --lang_code en --ref_audio /Volumes/致态2TB/nx-agents/education/v2/voice-en-master-reference.wav --ref_text "Your KYC got rejected again? Don't worry. Most rejections come down to just a few simple mistakes. Let's fix them together." --text "<line>" --output_path <dir> --file_prefix <name>
narration.english_voice_instruct: a cheerful young American woman in her twenties, warm and energetic, clear diction, friendly YouTube tutorial host
narration.sam_voice_design_instruct: a friendly adult American man new to crypto, natural and conversational, clear diction, curious but not cartoonish
narration.sam_voice_note: Task-specific brief requests Sam lines with this distinct VoiceDesign model; this overrides the older global owner note that male voice was not used.

open_visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S2 · E15' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
open_visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第2季 · 第15集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。

shots.visual_en: Sam sees a green candle and goes to tap Buy; Nexubo covers the button.
shots.visual_zh: 小白看到绿色蜡烛就按买入，小纳把按钮盖住。

text.en: Green means it keeps going up next, right?
text.zh-Hans: 绿色，是不是表示下一秒还会涨？

shots.source_visual_zh: 小白看到绿色蜡烛就按买入，小纳把按钮盖住。

shots.visual_en: A five-minute timeline unfolds: open 50,000, high 51,000, low 49,000, close 50,500 appear one by one.

text.en: One candle records four prices for one period: open, high, low and close. This is made-up five-minute data. It's not a promise about the next five minutes.
text.zh-Hans: 一根K线记录一个时间段的四个价格：开盘、最高、最低、收盘。这里是虚构的五分钟行情，不是未来五分钟的保证。

shots.visual_en: The body connects open and close; wicks reach the high and low. All four labels stay on screen.
shots.visual_zh: 实体连接开收，影线伸向最高与最低；四个标签一直保留。

text.en: The body shows the gap between open and close. The wicks mark the highest and lowest prices in that period. A candle that hasn't finished yet keeps changing with new trades.
text.zh-Hans: 实体帮助你看开盘与收盘的差，影线标出期间到过的高低点。还没结束的这根线，会随着新成交继续改变。

shots.source_visual_zh: 实体连接开收，影线伸向最高与最低；四个标签一直保留。

shots.visual_en: The same market switches between a 5-minute and a 1-hour view; the characters don't change market.
shots.visual_zh: 同一行情在五分钟和一小时视图切换，角色没有换市场。

text.en: Why does the chart look different when I switch the time frame?
text.zh-Hans: 为什么切换周期，图看起来就不一样？

text.en: Each candle now covers a different length of time. Read the time frame first, then the shape. Don't mistake five minutes for a day.
text.zh-Hans: 每根线代表的时间长度变了。先读周期，再谈形状，不能把五分钟当成一天。

shots.source_visual_zh: 同一行情在五分钟和一小时视图切换，角色没有换市场。

shots.visual_en: The colour theme flips; the up/down text and +/− signs stay the same. The next candle is still drawn as a question mark.
shots.visual_zh: 颜色主题切换，涨跌文字与加减号不变；下一根线仍画问号。
shots.onscreen_text_en: Read the legend and the numbers

text.en: Apps may use different colours for up and down, so read the legend and the numbers. Past moves can be informative, but one candle can't guarantee the next move.
text.zh-Hans: 不同应用可能使用不同涨跌颜色，所以要看图例和数字。历史走势可以提供信息，但单根K线不能保证下一步涨跌。

shots.source_visual_zh: 颜色主题切换，涨跌文字与加减号不变；下一根线仍画问号。

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Find this candle's high and close.'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：找出这根线的最高价与收盘价。

text.zh-Hans: 最高五万一，收盘五万零五百。

text.en: Read the record first. Don't treat a record as a prophecy.
text.zh-Hans: 先读记录，别把记录当预言。

question.en: Find this candle's high and close.
question.zh-Hans: 找出这根K线的最高价和收盘价。

shots.source_visual_zh: 题目：找出这根线的最高价与收盘价。

text.en: 'I have 1,000 and only want to risk 20. So I go all in?' Next: how much to buy.
text.zh-Hans: “我有一千，只想亏二十，那就全买进去？”下一集：先想能亏多少。

text.en: 'I have 1,000 and only want to risk 20. So I go all in?' Next: how much to buy.
text.zh-Hans: “我有一千，只想亏二十，那就全买进去？”下一集：先想能亏多少。

end_hook.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
end_hook.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

close_visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
close_visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。

goal.en: Read open, high, low, close and the time frame; don't treat colour or a single shape as a prediction.
goal.zh-Hans: 读出开、高、低、收与时间周期，不把颜色或单根形态当预测。

page_cta.line_en: Want a new chart-reading drill each week? Join our Telegram channel.
page_cta.line_zh: 想每周收到一道看图练习？加入我们的 Telegram 频道。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: On a virtual candle, tap open, high, low and close, and confirm the chart time frame.
exercise.task_zh: 在虚拟K线上点击开、高、低、收，并确认图表周期。

red_lines: Up/down must be shown with text or symbols, not colour alone ｜ 涨跌除颜色外必须有文字或符号
Never imply fixed win rates for chart patterns in a beginner animation ｜ 不在入门动画中暗示固定形态胜率
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
